source_text:
3.25 Τοῦ αὐτοῦ· πρὸς πληγὴν ἰοβόλων ἐνύδρων ζῴων ἀφλέγμαντον Γῆ Λημνία πρὸς
τὰς τῶν θαλαττίων ἰοβόλων πληγὰς ἁρμόζει μετ' οἴνου διδομένη, καὶ λευκὰς ὀρεινὴ
ὄξει καταπλασσομένη παραπλησίως ἰᾶται.
pass_a_gloss: 3.25 Of-the-same: toward a-strike of-venomous in-water animals uninflamed. Earth Lemnian toward the of-the-sea venomous strikes is-fitted, with wine being-given; and white mountain-earth with-vinegar being-plastered similarly it-heals.
pass_b_english: Of the same: toward a strike of venomous water-animals, so as to keep it uninflamed. Lemnian earth is fitted toward the strikes of venomous sea-creatures, being given with wine; and the white mountain-earth, being plastered with vinegar, heals similarly.

choices.why: Heading for the strike/remedy: keep it from φλεγμονή. Not 'Lemnian earth without inflammation' as a quality of the earth.
rejected: uninflamed as a property of the soil

choices.why: ὄξος is vinegar in medical Greek. Not mineral acid, and not the subject of ἰᾶται.
καταπλάσσω is to apply a poultice. Not 'being shaped'.
Fem. sc. γῆ, the mountain earth plastered with vinegar. Not 'mountainous' modifying acid.
Lock prints λευκὰς ὀρεινή; taken as γῆ λευκὴ ὀρεινή (white mountain-earth), parallel to Γῆ Λημνία.
rejected: white strikes that the mountain heals

choices.why: Lemnian earth is suited to those strikes. The wounds themselves do not 'fit'.
rejected: fits as the subject of the πληγαί

choices.why: ἰοβόλος, venom-casting. Lemma is not ἰός.
πληγή is a blow/strike of a venomous animal, distinct from δῆγμα 'bite' in 3.24.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
